thread.title: 9 11 Evidence Research

content.text: Conduct deep research using public primary sources and contemporary reporting on three separate questions about 9/11. (1) Identify Saudi-linked people documented or alleged to have helped hijackers Nawaf al-Hazmi and Khalid al-Mihdhar, including Omar al-Bayoumi, Fahad al-Thumairy and other genuinely supported leads. Distinguish direct acts, documented contacts, judicial preliminary inferences, the 2021 FBI closure conclusions, allegations and unresolved CIA liaison questions. Check for actual dated communications, payments or records linking any of them to Urban Moving Systems (UMS), Max Movers or their personnel; report negative and inconclusive comparisons. (2) Identify pre- and post-9/11 WTC, street, toll, surveillance, security-camera or news footage that could establish whether a UMS or Max vehicle was in lower Manhattan or at the complex, and trace actual FBI camera leads, camera location, original/derivative custody, timestamps, calibration, identification and disposition. Distinguish New Jersey Exxon footage from WTC city cameras; do not assume that any footage shows UMS. (3) Trace the original source, exact date and scope of claims that WTC bomb-detection dogs, patrols, security or power were removed or changed before September 11, including Loose Change and the September 12, 2001 Los Angeles Times account, and seek Port Authority security records and contrary evidence. Distinguish removal of an increased alert from the claim that all dogs were removed; investigate power-down claims separately. Provide exact links, pages, contemporaneous source wording, conflicting accounts, missing records, clear source provenance, what would strengthen or disconfirm each link, and a bounded search log. Do not imply nationality proves agency affiliation. Do not contact anyone, send requests, make payments, disclose private records, or assert that search leads are established facts.
